name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 29 times in 8 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 60 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2026-04-27, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.70 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
